description: Source code for the 'auth' package in the etcd client v3, defining authentication-related interfaces, responses, constants, and client implementation.

classes.name: authClient
classes.description: Implementation of the Auth interface, acting as a client to the etcd auth gRPC service.

methods.name: NewAuth
methods.description: Creates a new Auth implementation with a given client.

methods.name: NewAuthFromAuthClient
methods.description: Creates a new Auth implementation from an existing pb.AuthClient.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication and retrieves a token.

methods.name: AuthEnable
methods.description: Enables authentication on the etcd cluster.

methods.name: AuthDisable
methods.description: Disables authentication on the etcd cluster.

methods.name: AuthStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authentication status of the cluster.

methods.name: UserAdd
methods.description: Adds a new user to the cluster.

methods.name: UserAddWithOptions
methods.description: Adds a new user with specific options.

methods.name: UserDelete
methods.description: Deletes a user from the cluster.

methods.name: UserChangePassword
methods.description: Changes a user's password.

methods.name: UserGrantRole
methods.description: Grants a role to a user.

methods.name: UserGet
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info of a user.

methods.name: UserList
methods.description: Lists all users.

methods.name: UserRevokeRole
methods.description: Revokes a role from a user.

methods.name: RoleAdd
methods.description: Adds a new role.

methods.name: RoleGrantPermission
methods.description: Grants a permission to a role.

methods.name: RoleGet
methods.description: Retrieves info of a role.

methods.name: RoleList
methods.description: Lists all roles.

methods.name: RoleRevokePermission
methods.description: Revokes a permission from a role.

methods.name: RoleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a role.
